title: 第13章 三头怪蛇第14章 我们不合适
slug: 惊天剑帝第7906章空气太敏感
content_zh:
走入一寸山，林白便警惕起来。
一寸山地貌阴冷潮湿，树木全部枯死，石块上长着青苔，乌鸦在树梢上叫唤得烦心。
此地一看就不是什么好地方。
往里走了几步，突然地面传来一阵轻微的颤抖，林白惊讶的抬头一看，山顶上一块大石头被人推下来，直奔他而来。
顺着石头的背后，一条长约百米，长着三颗脑袋的怪蛇，凶神恶煞的从山顶上飞扑下来，对准他而来！
铮！
林白一看，斩灵剑率先出鞘，对着面前滚动过来的大石一剑斩下，将大石从中破开。
嘶——
大石破开的刹那，临边看见在大石的背后露出三头怪蛇，齐齐的向他张嘴撕咬而来。
“孽畜，正在找你呢，没想到你自己跑出来受死了！”林白冷笑一声，灵巧的避开了三头怪蛇的袭击，顺势退后了十米，与它拉开了距离，重新调整攻势。
这三头怪蛇，常年盘踞在一寸山，凡是来到一寸山的武者，在不知情的情况下，全部都被三头怪蛇给活吃了。
仗着自己武道八重的高深武道，三头怪蛇从来就没有遇到过对手。
而一寸山实在是太贫瘠了，除了这头十分厉害的怪蛇外，没有任何珍稀的灵药和矿石，一般武者都不愿意来这里招惹怪蛇。
可是林白就不同了，这三头怪蛇，武道八重的修为，对林白说来可是有着很大的诱惑。
妖兽品阶越高，体内的气血之力就越充沛，对神魔镇狱诀就越有帮助！
三头怪蛇仰天嘶吼起来，左边的头颅喷出一嘴烈焰，直射林白而去。
而右边的头颅喷出一嘴寒冰。
“我靠！会吐火啊！”
林白急忙闪避开来，三头怪蛇仗着自己吐火吐冰，不断的追着林白在一寸山上，东躲西藏。
“果然难缠！”

林白咒骂一声。脚步踩着石块之上，一跃而上。
三头怪蛇张口便是一口烈焰喷射而来，林白目光一狠：“一味的躲避，也不是办法！”
“那好吧，来拼一手吧！”
“一剑飙血！”
一剑出，将烈焰斩碎后，剑光急速的击中三头怪蛇的脖子之上。
三头怪蛇传来凄厉的惨叫之声。
“畜生，受死！”
林白一击得手，快步冲上前去，想要在三头怪蛇没有火焰和寒冰封锁之时，击杀三头怪蛇。
可就在林白靠近三头怪蛇的刹那，那中间的头颅，愤怒的张开了大嘴，其中射出一股腐蚀性的光线，击中地面上，将大一片的地面立刻腐蚀了一个深坑。
“还好老子躲得快，否则的话，这击中我了，还不得将我瞬间腐烂啊。”林白心有余悸的看着地面上腐蚀后修炼的大坑。
吼——，吼——，吼——
三头怪蛇的三头齐齐巨吼起来。
“看来要拼命了！”
“雷神剑！”
咔咔咔——
九天之上突然一道神雷破空落下，击中林白的剑上，剑身上立刻就浮现起了一条条紫色的雷霆。
“斩！”
林白飞冲上去，破开三头怪蛇喷射出来的火焰，一剑落下，将三头怪蛇的一个头颅斩落下来。
一个头颅被斩，疼得三头怪蛇的叫声无比的凄厉。
“受死吧！”
content_en:
Lin Bai became vigilant as he walked into Yicun Mountain.
The landscape of Yicun Mountain is cold and damp, all the trees are dead, moss is growing on the rocks, and crows are calling annoyingly on the treetops.
This place doesn't look like a good place at first glance.
After walking a few steps in, a slight tremor suddenly came from the ground. Lin Bai looked up in surprise and saw a large rock being pushed down from the top of the mountain and heading straight towards him.
Along the back of the stone, a strange snake about a hundred meters long with three heads flew down from the top of the mountain with a ferocious look, aiming at him!
Zheng!
When Lin Bai saw it, he unsheathed the Spirit-Slaying Sword first and slashed down on the large stone rolling in front of him, breaking it open.
Hiss——
The moment the boulder broke open, Linbian saw three strange snakes emerging from behind the boulder, all of them opened their mouths and bit at him.
"The evil beast, I'm looking for you. I didn't expect you to run out and die!" Lin Bai sneered, deftly avoiding the attack of the three-headed monster snake, retreated ten meters, distanced himself from it, and readjusted his offensive.
These three-headed monster snakes have been entrenched in Yi-Cun Mountain all year round. All warriors who came to Yi-Cun Mountain were eaten alive by the three-headed monster snakes without knowing it.
Relying on his profound martial arts at the eighth level of martial arts, the three-headed monster snake has never met an opponent.
But Yicun Mountain is too barren. Except for this very powerful strange snake, there are no rare elixirs and ores. Most warriors are not willing to come here to provoke the strange snake.
But Lin Bai was different. This three-headed monster snake and the eighth level of martial arts were very tempting to Lin Bai.
The higher the level of the monster, the more abundant the energy and blood in the body, and the more helpful it is for the gods and demons to suppress the prison!
The three-headed monster snake looked up to the sky and roared, and the left head spurted out a mouthful of flames, shooting directly at Lin Bai.
The head on the right spurted out a mouthful of ice.
"Holy crap! He can breathe fire!"
Lin Bai hurriedly dodged away, and the three-headed monster snake relied on itself to spit out fire and ice, and kept chasing Lin Bai on Inch Mountain, hiding here and there.
"It's really difficult!"
Lin Bai cursed. He stepped on the stones and jumped up.
The three-headed monster snake opened its mouth and spit out a mouthful of flames. Lin Bai's eyes were sharp: "Just avoiding it is not the answer!"
"Okay then, let's have a fight!"
"One sword spurts blood!"
The sword came out and chopped the flames into pieces, then the sword light quickly hit the neck of the three-headed monster snake.
A shrill scream came from the three-headed monster snake.
"Beast, die!"
Lin Bai succeeded with one blow and rushed forward quickly, hoping to kill the three-headed snake when it was not blocked by fire and ice.
But the moment Lin Bai approached the three-headed monster snake, the middle head opened its mouth angrily, and a corrosive light shot out, hitting the ground, immediately corroding a large area of ​​the ground into a deep pit.
"Fortunately, I hid quickly, otherwise, if this hit me, I would be rotten instantly." Lin Bai looked at the large corrosion pit on the ground after training with lingering fear.
Roar——, roar——, roar——
The three heads of the three-headed snake roared together.
"Looks like we have to fight hard!"
"Thunder Sword!"
Kakaka——
Suddenly, a divine thunder fell from the sky and hit Lin Bai's sword. Purple thunderbolts immediately appeared on the sword.
"Cut!"
Lin Baifei rushed forward, broke through the flames sprayed by the three-headed snake, and fell with his sword, cutting off one of the three-headed snake's heads.
A head was chopped off, causing the three-headed snake to scream in agony.
"Suffer death!"
